bootstrap.rule_reference: A5.3.2 / A5.4.2 / A5.6.1: PCG64 seed 20261107, 4,000 draws, linear .025/.975 quantiles

chart_projectors.eligibility: A5.8.3 destruction-eligibility rule applied to chart projector frames: per arm, coverage >= 0.90 and weighted absolute cosine <= 0.20 computed on the projected-edit blocks P_out^T D P_in (intact versus control), over the full frozen edited-token inventory; written to the destruction-audit artefact; no seed search after a failure

intact.frames: block_projectors(out, in, k=4, seed): torch.Generator('cpu').manual_seed(seed); P_out = QR(randn(out, min(4, out))) then P_in = QR(randn(in, min(4, in))) from the same generator, positive-diagonal sign convention

permuted_projector.construction: within each compatibility group (exact role string AND exact tensor shape) the intact projector identities (tensor_seed of the tensor name), listed by ascending layer, are moved by the seeded derangement: the tensor at position j uses the intact frames of the tensor at position derangement[j]; singleton groups stay fixed and are disclosed, never reshaped

random_frame.construction: independently seeded random frames: block_projectors(out, in, k=4, seed(domain, key)) replaces the intact frames of that tensor; every chart-derived scalar is recomputed; nothing else changes

chart_projectors.registered_by: A5.8.3; domains and keys registered 10 Nov 2026 (PREREG A5 freeze-pass amendments, Board A freeze review edit 6), before any chart or field exists
chart_projectors.rule_reference: A5.8.2 (seed 20261107); src/wsp/features/response_chart.py:tensor_seed = SeedSequence([20261107, crc32(tensor name)]) first uint64
chart_projectors.status: secondary/descriptive chart arm; registered controls, not measured destruction passes

derivation.rule: seed(domain, key) = int.from_bytes(sha256(UTF-8 domain + key)[:8], 'big') mod 2^63 (the A5.3.3 rotation convention, applied to the A5.8.3 domains)
derivation.status: A5.8.3 registers the two domains; the key formats below are chair-default proposals for Board A acceptance at freeze, fixed here before any field exists (no seed search after a failure, A5.8.3)

fisher_sampling.rule_reference: A5.8.1 'one model-sampled target per valid token, fixed RNG'; src/wsp/features/response_field.py SEED = 20261107 (torch.Generator('cpu').manual_seed)

permuted_field.construction: within each compatibility group (exact role string AND exact tensor shape), layer indices sorted ascending are permuted by the seeded derangement; whole gradient/factor tuples of all objectives move together; singleton groups stay fixed and are disclosed, never reshaped
permuted_field.derangement: numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(seed)).permutation(n) repeated until no fixed point (scripts/a5_build_panels.py:derangement); n = 1 is fixed
permuted_field.note: test vectors use a synthetic key and only pin the functions; the actual groups come from the frozen supported-module inventory at G2 staging and are written to the destruction-audit artefact (A5.8.3)

random_field.construction: per tensor token, an independent Gaussian gradient rescaled to that token's intact Frobenius norm (not one global norm); zero-norm tokens stay zero with explicit flags; random covariance factors use Gaussian eigenframes with the intact spectra; every field-derived scalar is recomputed
random_field.generator: torch.Generator('cpu').manual_seed(seed); gradient = randn(out, in) in fp32 then rescaled; frames = sign-corrected QR (positive diagonal, zero -> +1) of randn(d, d), as A5.3.3

rotation.rule_reference: PREREG A5.3.3: SHA256 of '20261107:rotation:' + canonical ID, first eight bytes big-endian, mod 2^63; torch generator cloned per tensor; out x out then in x in Gaussian draws; sign-corrected QR

simulation.construction: numpy.random.SeedSequence(20261107).spawn(3) -> PCG64 generators in the order [panels, signs, resolution]
